meta.name: full-output-enforcement
meta.description: Overrides default LLM truncation behavior. Enforces complete code generation, bans placeholder patterns, and handles token-limit splits cleanly. Apply to any task requiring exhaustive, unabridged output.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 强制生成完整代码，禁止占位符截断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到LLM输出被截断或出现占位符的问题
copy.tagline_en: Force complete code generation, ban placeholder truncation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face LLM output truncation or placeholder issues

howto.what: Claude 把每个任务当正式交付：要整个文件就给整个文件，要 5 个组件就给 5 个，不用「// ...」等占位符省略，也不写「其余同理」代替正文。输出接近上限时停在断点并标记进度，等你回复 continue 续写。
howto.when: 当你要求完整、无删减的输出时接管，比如要整份文件、全部组件或逐条答案；写作中写了「全部」「完整」等要求时同样适用。

say.text: 输出完整的配置文件，不要省略任何部分。
say.note: 会给出完整文件而不是骨架。

say.text: 把这 5 个组件的代码全部写完。

say.note: 从上次停下的位置接着写，不重述。

howto.what_en: Claude delivers every request in full: a whole file means the whole file, 5 components means 5. Placeholders like '// ...' are banned. Near the token limit it pauses at a clean breakpoint and marks progress.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever you ask for exhaustive, unabridged output — a full file, all components, or every answer — and no part may be shortened.

say_en.text: Output the complete config file with nothing omitted.
say_en.note: Gives the full file, not a skeleton.

say_en.text: Write out the code for all 5 components.
say_en.note: Delivers every component and checks the count.
